package catalog

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	acton "github.com/ton-blockchain/acton/packages/abi-go"
)

type toggle = CBoolEnum_e9337cdcd0974cbcToggleT1
type state = CBoolEnum_e9337cdcd0974cbcStateT2

const off toggle = CBoolEnum_e9337cdcd0974cbcToggleT1OffM0
const on toggle = CBoolEnum_e9337cdcd0974cbcToggleT1OnM1

// Compile-time checks for the generated boolean field and Cell<T> getter types.
var _ CBoolEnum_e9337cdcd0974cbcTypedCellG5Result = on
var _ = CBoolEnum_e9337cdcd0974cbcTypedCellG5Args{VF0: on}
var _ = state{OffF0: off, OnF1: on}

func method(t *testing.T, c *acton.Contract, name string) *acton.GetMethod {
	t.Helper()
	for i := range c.GetMethods {
		if c.GetMethods[i].Name == name {
			return &c.GetMethods[i]
		}
	}
	t.Fatal(name)
	return nil
}

func TestBooleanEnumGeneratedBindings(t *testing.T) {
	c, other := ByID("bool-enum"), ByID("unrelated")
	if len(Contracts) != 2 || c == nil || other == nil {
		t.Fatal("boolean enum lost a catalog entry")
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		value toggle
		boc   string
	}{
		{off, "te6cckEBAQEAAwAAAUD20kA0"},
		{on, "te6cckEBAQEAAwAAAcCO6ba2"},
	} {
		golden, err := acton.DecodeBOC(tc.boc)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		for _, idx := range []int{0, 1} {
			binding := c.Messages["incoming_messages"][idx]
			if binding.Unsupported != "" {
				t.Fatal(binding.Unsupported)
			}
			root, err := binding.Encode(tc.value)
			if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(root.Hash(), golden.Hash()) {
				t.Fatalf("boolean enum cell golden: %v", err)
			}
			decoded, err := binding.Decode(golden)
			if err != nil || decoded != bool(tc.value) {
				t.Fatalf("boolean enum JSON value: %#v %v", decoded, err)
			}
		}
		m := method(t, c, "typed_cell")
		if m.Unsupported != "" {
			t.Fatal(m.Unsupported)
		}
		stack, err := m.EncodeArgs(map[string]any{"v": tc.value})
		if err != nil || len(stack) != 1 || stack[0].Type != "cell" {
			t.Fatalf("typed-cell getter encode: %+v %v", stack, err)
		}
		got, err := acton.DecodeBOC(stack[0].Value.(string))
		if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(got.Hash(), golden.Hash()) {
			t.Fatalf("typed-cell getter golden: %v", err)
		}
		decoded, err := m.DecodeResult([]acton.StackValue{{Type: "cell", Value: tc.boc}})
		if err != nil || decoded != bool(tc.value) {
			t.Fatalf("typed-cell getter decode: %#v %v", decoded, err)
		}
	}
	for _, bad := range []any{"false", "true", "0", "-1", 0, 1, nil} {
		if _, err := c.Messages["incoming_messages"][0].Encode(bad); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("accepted nonboolean cell value %#v", bad)
		}
	}
	falseCell, err := acton.DecodeBOC("te6cckEBAQEAAwAAAUD20kA0")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := c.Messages["incoming_messages"][2].Decode(falseCell); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("decoded undeclared boolean enum member")
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"direct", "default_on", "default_off", "nested"} {
		m := method(t, c, name)
		if !strings.Contains(m.Unsupported, "boolean-backed enum stack representation") || m.EncodeArgs != nil || m.DecodeResult != nil {
			t.Fatalf("guessed stack representation: %+v", m)
		}
	}
	for _, input := range []any{map[string]any{}, state{OffF0: off, OnF1: on}} {
		root, err := c.Storage.Encode(input)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		// Default state is exactly bits 01, with no enum tags or references.
		s := root.BeginParse()
		bits, err := s.LoadUInt(2)
		if err != nil || bits != 1 || s.BitsLeft() != 0 || s.RefsNum() != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("boolean enum defaults: %d %v", bits, err)
		}
		decoded, err := c.Storage.Decode(root)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		data, err := json.Marshal(decoded)
		if err != nil || string(data) != `{"off":false,"on":true}` {
			t.Fatalf("boolean enum state JSON: %s %v", data, err)
		}
	}
	m := method(t, c, "state_cell")
	stack, err := m.EncodeArgs(map[string]any{"v": map[string]any{}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	decoded, err := m.DecodeResult(stack)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(decoded)
	if err != nil || string(data) != `{"off":false,"on":true}` {
		t.Fatalf("typed-cell struct defaults: %s %v", data, err)
	}
	// Ordinary bool getters still use TVM -1; unrelated integer defaults stay numeric.
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		contract   *acton.Contract
		name, want string
	}{
		{c, "ordinary", "-1"}, {other, "identity", "7"},
	} {
		m := method(t, tc.contract, tc.name)
		stack, err := m.EncodeArgs(nil)
		if err != nil || len(stack) != 1 || stack[0].Type != "int" || stack[0].Value != tc.want {
			t.Fatalf("unrelated getter/default: %+v %v", stack, err)
		}
	}
	root, err := other.Storage.Encode("42")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	decoded, err = other.Storage.Decode(root)
	if err != nil || decoded != "42" {
		t.Fatalf("unrelated contract: %#v %v", decoded, err)
	}
}
